tasks.fmt: deno fmt --check deno.json README.md component-manifest.json main.ts src
tasks.verify: deno task fmt && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task test && deno task runtime:check
tasks.dev: deno task runtime:check && deno desktop --no-prompt --deny-import --hmr -P=desktop main.ts
tasks.package: deno task runtime:check && deno desktop --no-prompt --deny-import -P=desktop --output=dist/CasysDigitalThread.app main.ts && deno run --no-prompt --allow-run=/usr/bin/plutil,/usr/bin/codesign src/build/finalize-macos.ts dist/CasysDigitalThread.app
